body: Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI. Compare performance of GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Simple declarative configs with command line and CI/CD integration.  Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.
plain_description: **Evaluate prompts and test AI applications for security risks before release.** Compare model performance side by side and automate checks in CI/CD.
technical_description: Promptfoo is a command-line tool and library for evaluating and red-teaming LLM-based applications. It supports automated prompt and model evaluations, vulnerability scanning, model comparisons, CI/CD checks, and pull request code scanning. Evaluations run locally; most LLM providers require an API key.
title: Promptfoo
